comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Summary Information***
It will open a extra map interface while sailing on sea or exploring a land. Size will be ALWAYS same regardless which rank you got like Snipe Said. Battousai is also right, it prolongs the duration of the Surveying effect.

Advantages:
> You don't get lost while sailing/exploring, even if your compas becomes useless.
> Coördinates at seas, which makes determinating locations way accurate.
> When you do quest/maps a star will appear on your map, after using observe/map (you need to get close enough, before the star appears).
> Very useful for those, who uses GVONavi. You can steer in which direction you want to sail in long range and also check your shipspeed in kt.

Important note for GVOnavi users with a alt:
When you're using surveying on both while sailing and also far away each other, then your GVOnavi becomes messy when switching from screens and your kt will show huge numbers.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This skill can actually be used in the Labyrinth dungeon. It will display a map of your current floor's layout, even noting the exit's location (if you pass close enough to it, of course). As large and twisting as the Labyrinth can be, this is very handy.

But because your combat action gauge is affected by loss of vigour (always fight in land/deck battles with max vig if possible), I would suggest that any Labyrinth fleet Admiral consider taking an item like the Quadrant (sold for cheap in many craft shops) or a Sextant (less easy to acquire, but more durability uses) along to use as the effects of both mimic Surveying skill.

Oh. And four days from now, there will be one other dungeon in UWO where the Surveying skill can be used... heh. Cheers, and great online voyaging, all.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
I learned this skill can be refined one day, and have been trying to find a good way to rank it up to R15. Here are the three methods I've found work best!

#1: Use it when at sea.
If you sail a lot to adventure or Nanban, this is easy. On the downside you need to be sure to keep money on hand and equipment will lose dura at sea, so you can't just camp outside a port to do it.

#2: Use it in land zones.
If you have Marching skill, this is a very easy way to do Surveying grind, and you can level them up together. But you need to reset your fatigue often because if it hits 100, you will "pass out" and lose money/some items. Storage rank reduces the losses, but it isn't quite perfect...

I think there's a third way but somebody told me it didn't work for them so I will research it further. And before I forget, here's the refine effect!

"When practicing surveying, expanding the detection range, using observation skills or treasure maps, the range in which discovered objects can be detected increases. --Azusa ? 2023-09-24 (Sun) 07:34:03"

I got the info from here.

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Update/230919update

But of course, the best way to gain prof on Surveying.. is to use it, preferably while it's favored. Good luck, Survey grinders. :)
